scope: Linux diagnostic artifact contracts, shared publisher, client, desktop workflow and canonical regression checks
verified: Export writes the exact reviewed preview bytes through the shared bounded artifact worker.
Exclusive publication, bounded readback, private paths and explicit filesystem effects remain separate from receipt status.
Read-only inspection preserves files and distinguishes missing, matching, conflicting and unreadable outcomes.
Cancellation acknowledgment preserves worker ownership until actual retirement; verified installation can win the race.
Actual owner, CLI, Rust foreign-client and standalone desktop scenarios cover publication and exact lost-reply reconciliation.
The GUI retains diagnostic observations separately from product state and preserves unavailable metrics.
Preview review binds its request identity and destination; destination edits, new captures and owner changes invalidate it.
Ordinary backpressure preserves captured work and exact reconciliation in the existing waiting slot.
Two safety admissions preserve back-to-back Mute and Stop without depending on worker scheduling.
Owner replacement preserves the original reconciliation rejection paths and prevents retargeting.
Semantic accessibility label lookup preserves the actual field labelled_by relationship.
Owned artifact test destinations use physical parent paths without weakening symlink rejection.

linux_native.diagnosis: The acceptance harness required receipt rows for successful diagnostic reads that the GUI adopts and retires.

limits: The deterministic held-read test proves waiting, its caption and safety availability; its Applied target does not prove a resend.
The separate actual lost-export case supplies successful manual exact replay evidence.
Native diagnostic window acceptance remains incomplete; no native lost reply, cancellation or replacement-owner fault was induced.
Filesystem name validation is not atomic with rename; bounded installed readback detects retained replacement effects.
The filesystem deadline is cooperative; a blocked syscall can delay cancellation and thread joining.
Runtime executable identity and checkout remain unavailable in shareable previews; test inventory is not attached and reproduction is incomplete.
This does not complete T14 through T18 or full T17 observability and release acceptance.
